display_name: HTTP-to-SMTP Gateway — Email Any UnitySVC SMTP Route

Connectivity test.description: POST a msg envelope through the gateway and expect 2xx (queued for the SMTP Gateway)

How to use this service.description: How HTTP-to-SMTP Gateway works, which routes you can target, and what the forwarded credential means

Python code example.description: Python (httpx) example — post a faithful email payload to an SMTP Gateway route

default.description: Free | one SMTP Gateway route stored as a customer secret

name: http-to-smtp-gateway

from.description: Envelope sender for this enrollment. Used as the MIME `From` when the posted payload carries no `from` of its own.

target.description: Route on the UnitySVC SMTP Gateway to deliver to, used as the SMTP username — a service route (`smtp-byok`, `smtp-to-mailbox`), an alias (`a/alerts`), a broadcast group (`b/relay`), or an enrollment code. No scheme, no leading slash.

to.description: Default recipient for this enrollment. Used when the posted payload carries no `to` of its own. Routes on the SMTP Gateway resolve on the username, not the recipient, but a recipient still travels with the message for any leg that really relays it.
